comps.title: 앙코르 이즈리얼
comps.augTip: Nasus is the default tank, but you can also play for Galio / Ksante 3 main tank. Ezreal 3 is the main carry but ideally you have both Ezreal / Lucian fully itemized end game. Always end the game on 4 Encore.
tips: 2스테이지
Open with a win streak Ezreal start and itemize him ASAP. If you play 3 Heartsteel, bias Ezreal. Tank Sett 2 early.
3스테이지
6레벨로 올려 2성을 맞춰 보드를 안정시키고 3스테이지를 연승하세요. 그다음 돈을 모아 50골드 위에서 조금씩 리롤해 3성을 맞추세요.
4스테이지
Finish your 3* then push levels for more 4 Encore. Leftover utility / AD on Lucian. Any 4 Encore will do, but Jhin / Yuumi are best.

comps.title: 고스 배디
comps.augTip: Tank Leona or Galio 2 until you scale Mundo 2 with max HP. Nunu holds utility / mana items.
tips: 2스테이지
Ideally play for win streak around 2* upgraded units. Slam anything usable with a heavy priority on Sword components.
3스테이지
Maintain your win streak. The goal will be to get to Stage 4 healthy and trade HP while skipping 8. Look for econ augments to early level or item augments.
4스테이지
If healthy, you can sac Stage 4 and push level 9 by 5-1 / 5-2. Aim for around 70+ gold for the rolldown. Look for 8 traits to unlock Smeech.

comps.title: Jazz Jhin
comps.augTip: Early Renata + Nasus is the best way to unlock early Thresh. If you itemize Vlad, make sure he has a mana item so he can cast the Chandelier. Positioning in this way will naturally unlock Vlad but you can move up units if needed. Play 6 Classical only with emblem.
tips: 2스테이지
Play Classical ASAP, preferably around Renata and Nasus. Samira can hold Jhin items, but she isn't great until 2* so prioritize playing stronger board.
3스테이지
Level and add in frontline for more stall. Econ up heavily. If all goes well, unlock Thresh by mid Stage 3. Itemize him immediately.
4스테이지
Level to 8 at 4-1/4-2 with Thresh unlocked. Position to unlock Vladimir. Look for Jhin 2, Thresh 2, and Mel then go 9 for Smeech / 5 costs.

comps.title: DIEGO
comps.augTip: Keep the Decibel levels balanced between AD / HP because there are diminishing returns maxing either stat. If you can't get 4 Trickshot, flex in Choreographers. Twisted Fate gives free anti-heal but if you can't reach him build your own anti-heal item.
tips: 2스테이지
Ideally play around a Viego opener that can win streak to scale his swords. This composition is very Sword hungry so take Sword augments / carousels.
3스테이지
Add more Trickshot and frontline as you go. Try to focus on itemizing 1 of Draven / Viego first + tank before working on the other carry.
4스테이지
Aim to have Viego 2 and Draven 2 with upgraded frontline tank 2* by 4-1. Then econ up and slow roll for 3*. Once you finish, push levels for 4 Trickshot and Choreographer.

comps.title: 신동 말자하
comps.augTip: Malzahar provides free Shred so Void Staff / Ionic Spark is lower priority. Prodigy +1 is very good (cut Lux). True max cap of the board is Baron Nashor but many games you will end on Managers. Amumu 3 is a good alternative if you can't hit Ekko.
tips: 2스테이지
Ideally play around a Malzahar opener that can win streak. This composition is very Rod hungry so take Rod augments / carousels.
3스테이지
Add more Prodigy and frontline as you go. Finish Malzahar items by end of stage. If you are very rich, you can level to 7 early on 3-5 and roll for upgrades.
4스테이지
Aim to have Malazahar 2 and upgraded frontline tank 2* by 4-1. Then econ up and slow roll for 3*. Once you finish, push levels for Managers or Baron Nashor.

comps.title: 하이퍼팝 리롤
comps.augTip: Seraphine is optional carry but she can accelerate your econ heavily. Tristana 3 / Swain 3 is nice to have but luxury. End game, transfer utility items (Void Staff / Morello / Red Buff) to Teemo and carry Seraphine 3 with pure AP items.
tips: 2스테이지
Roll 4 times before Stage 2 carousel to unlock Seraphine and field her. Always field max Hyperpop to generate hype. Slam Ziggs / Kobuko items.
3스테이지
Slow roll above 50g on level 5 for Ziggs, Kobuko, Seraphine, and Lulu. Finish 3 items Ziggs and Kobuko.
4스테이지
Finish your 4th 3* and start leveling for more frontline. Level up for Choreographer or Arcanist. Teemo 2 with items caps your board.

comps.title: K/DA 리롤
comps.augTip: Seraphine is optional carry but she can accelerate your econ heavily. Can also chase Evelynn 3* or Kai'Sa 3* as an alternative duo carry.
tips: 2스테이지
Roll 4 times before Stage 2 carousel to unlock Seraphine and field her. Slam items on Neeko and Lillia for win streak.
3스테이지
Slow roll above 50g on level 5 for your K/DA units and Seraphine. Once you finish 1 cost 3*, level to 6 and roll for the 2 costs.
4스테이지
Finish your 4th 3* and start leveling for more frontline. Rush for 15 K/DA and frontline units. Akali 2 with items cap your board.

comps.title: 학살자 비에고
comps.augTip: 6 Slayer is optional but the 1 costs are quite weak end game. Comp is good with lots of artifacts. Make sure Amumu has no adjacent allies for Emo.
tips: 2스테이지
Ideally play around a Viego opener that can win streak to scale his swords. This composition is very Sword hungry so take Sword augments / carousels.
3스테이지
Add more Slayer and frontline as you go. Try to focus on itemizing 1 of Viego / Briar first + tank before working on the other carry.
4스테이지
Aim to have Viego 2, Briar 2, and Amumu 2* by 4-1. Then econ up and slow roll for 3*. You can play 6 Slayer temporarily until you hit Yorick / Garen.

comps.title: 이온 충격기
comps.augTip: Leona is flex. Gwen's Shroud gets max value if you clump, but greed it less if facing big AOE spells. Annie provides free anti-heal, but its not very reliable late game.
tips: 2스테이지
Open with upgraded Ionic Spark and slam items on Yunara for Jinx.  If you have Rageblade, prioritize 2 Frontman on 4 -> 2 Swiftstriker on 5.
3스테이지
If you are far ahead, you can level to 7 early to unlock Jinx. You can also go for 7 Ionic Spark on level 7 to get consumables.
4스테이지
Level to 8 and look for Jinx 2 and Shyvana 2. Aurora holds items until you unlock Gwen. Cap the board with Miss Fortune on 9.
